note: How a job spec is weighed against what Dan actually does, not against whatever matched first. Tiers carry the judgement; terms are only the detector.

adjacent.label: Next to his work, not inside it

areas.label: SimCorp Dimension
areas.line: SimCorp Dimension is the platform Dan is certified on and has delivered in since 2020, including two years inside SimCorp itself.

areas.label: Front office and order management
areas.line: Front office order, execution and trading workflow is the discipline Dan is hired for.

areas.label: IBOR and position keeping
areas.line: IBOR and position keeping run through almost every engagement on his CV.

areas.label: Risk management in the platform
areas.line: Risk in the platform sense: Risk Analysis Manager, credit limits, exposure and limit monitoring.

areas.label: Compliance
areas.line: Compliance Manager, online compliance rules, mandate and guideline monitoring.

areas.label: Alternative investments
areas.line: Alternative Investment Manager, private debt and fund decomposition, currently live at Nicola Wealth.

areas.label: Valuations, security setup and data
areas.line: Security and static setup, valuations and pricing precedence, data imports and their date handling, corporate actions and validation.

areas.label: Interfaces and connectivity
areas.line: FIX, SWIFT, STP and API integration across listed and OTC flow, including Bloomberg TSOX and FXGO and a custom FIX build via Adroit EMS.

areas.label: Regulatory reporting and ESG
areas.line: Regulatory reporting, SFDR, EU Taxonomy, CSRD and Pillar III, with the CFA ESG certificate behind it.

areas.label: Business analysis and delivery
areas.line: Business analyst, project manager, QA manager and scrum master across a decade of implementations.

areas.label: Extraction, SQL and Python
areas.line: Data Extractor Suite, DEX validation, Oracle and Postgres SQL, Python extensions and automated testing.

areas.label: Aladdin and Front Arena
areas.line: BlackRock Aladdin and Front Arena delivery alongside SimCorp, including Treasury on Front Arena at BNG Bank.

areas.label: AI and machine learning in finance
areas.line: Multi agent pipelines, RAG, LLM tooling and scheduled agents, built as his own products rather than talked about.

areas.label: Communication Server
areas.line: Dan has a strong background using the Communication Server, as part of data integration work. It supports what he delivers; it is not the discipline he leads on, and a role built around it is a weaker match than one built around front office, IBOR or integrations.

areas.label: Middle and back office
areas.line: Reconciliation, collateral, settlement and performance are part of his delivery rather than the seat he is hired into.

areas.label: Axioma and quantitative risk modelling
areas.line: Dan integrated the Axioma API at BNP Paribas. Building, calibrating or validating the risk models themselves is a different job, and a spec centred on that wants a consultant with hands on Axioma modelling experience.

areas.label: Core software engineering
areas.line: Dan writes Python and SQL to deliver, but a software engineering seat is not what he is hired for.

areas.label: Platforms outside the profile
areas.line: These platforms are not on Dan's CV. Adjacent experience often transfers, but he will say so rather than claim them.

areas.label: Permanent employment
areas.line: Dan works freelance and contract only.

verdicts.text: Strong fit. This spec sits inside what Dan does day to day.
Good fit. The centre of this spec is his territory, with some parts that support rather than lead his work.
Partial fit. Real overlap, but the weight of this spec sits beside his core rather than on it.
Weak fit. What this spec is mainly asking for is not the seat Dan is hired into.
